articles.title: Salman Khan Eyed for Cop Role Opposite Sanjay Dutt in Khalnayak Returns
articles.excerpt: Mid-Day reports Subhash Ghai's writers are building a good-Samaritan police officer around Salman for the Khalnayak sequel — but Ghai says scripting is still on and nothing is locked.
articles.image_caption: Salman Khan in a police uniform in a file image, beside the Khalnayak Returns poster showing Sanjay Dutt as Ballu. The sequel's writers are reported to be developing the cop role for Khan, though his casting has not been confirmed.
articles.nri_angle: A Salman-Dutt reunion in a 1993 cult sequel is a nostalgia event for diaspora audiences who grew up on both stars.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Manoj Bajpayee Says OTT Gives Sidelined Actors Respect and a Living
articles.excerpt: In an IANS interview as his Netflix thriller Gajab Raat premieres, Bajpayee says streaming gives actors mainstream cinema could not absorb the roles, respect and stability they were denied.
articles.nri_angle: Streaming is how diaspora audiences meet the character actors Bajpayee describes, on the same day as viewers in India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Jailer 2 Hindi Earns Rs 43.8 Crore in 15 Days, Books 68% Profit Over Breakeven
articles.excerpt: Rajinikanth's Tamil film, released in Hindi dubbed version on October 15, has crossed its Rs 26 crore breakeven with Rs 17.8 crore in profit, Koimoi reported — while the all-language India net total reached Rs 429.55 crore and worldwide gross Rs 766.65 crore, according to Sacnilk.
articles.nri_angle: The Hindi version's profit run matters to North Indian and diaspora audiences who discovered the Tamil original on streaming; the film now has six days of clear run before Ramayana Part One arrives.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Ramayana Presales: Canada and US Diaspora Buy 88,772 Tickets Worth $1.7 Million
articles.excerpt: North America is Ramayana: Part One's biggest overseas market, with premiere shows alone selling 29,175 tickets for $647,400 ahead of the November 5 release.
articles.nri_angle: Canadian and US diaspora audiences have bought 88,772 Ramayana presale tickets worth $1.7 million, making North America the film's top overseas market.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Ahan Shetty Begins Shooting Hindi Action Drama Sanki in Bhopal on October 30
articles.excerpt: Directed by Tinu Suresh Desai and written by Gyanendra Vasudev, the Hindi film pairs a love story with large-scale action and is slated for theatres in the first half of 2027.
articles.image_caption: Ahan Shetty, who began shooting the Hindi action drama Sanki in Bhopal on October 30.
articles.nri_angle: Sanki is Ahan Shetty's next theatrical outing after Border 2, with a first-half 2027 release planned.

articles.title: Aditi Rao Hydari Is the Only Bollywood Actor in Pirelli Calendar 2027
articles.excerpt: The 2027 Pirelli Calendar, titled 'India, Beyond a Single Gaze', was photographed entirely in India and features nine women with ties to the country, photographed by Sølve Sundsbø and Avani Rai.
articles.nri_angle: The India-themed edition puts diaspora figures including Padma Lakshmi, Freida Pinto, Rupi Kaur and Anoushka Shankar alongside India-based talent.

articles.title: Drishyam 3 Earns $6.71 Million in North America, Beating Drishyam 2 by 81 Percent
articles.excerpt: Koimoi puts the Ajay Devgn thriller at $6.71 million (Rs 63.88 crore) in the US and Canada after 26 days, 81.35 percent above Drishyam 2's lifetime $3.7 million and a North American career best for Devgn.
articles.nri_angle: Drishyam 3's $6.71 million North American gross shows US and Canadian audiences sustaining a Hindi thriller for 26 days, making it Ajay Devgn's biggest film in the territory.

articles.title: Ramayana Sells 1.33 Lakh Day One Tickets in National Chains

articles.title: Avengers: Doomsday Will Open in India a Day Before the US, Marvel Confirms in Diwali Surprise
articles.excerpt: Robert Downey Jr. and Chris Evans announced in a Marvel India Diwali video that the film releases in Indian theatres on December 17, 2026 — a day ahead of the US — in English, Hindi, Tamil and Telugu.
articles.image_caption: Doctor Doom appears alongside Chris Evans and Robert Downey Jr. in Marvel India's Diwali announcement video. Avengers: Doomsday will release in India on December 17, a day before the United States.
articles.nri_angle: US-based Marvel fans will get the film on December 18 — a day after India — so diaspora viewers who want to stay spoiler-free should plan for opening weekend and mute social feeds on December 17.

articles.title: PVR INOX Posts Record Quarter as India Box Office Crosses Rs 4,000 Crore
articles.excerpt: India's gross box office reached Rs 4,443 crore in July-September, the first quarter above Rs 4,000 crore, as PVR INOX profit more than doubled to Rs 273 crore.
articles.image_caption: PVR INOX Superplex Mall of India in Noida. PVR INOX reported its highest-ever quarterly revenue of Rs 2,133 crore in Q2 FY27, up 17% year on year, with profit after tax up 111% to Rs 273.3 crore.
articles.image_credit: Photo: Pooja.sirsat26 via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0)
articles.nri_angle: Record Indian box office across Hindi, regional and Hollywood films signals a theatrical slate diaspora audiences will see in US and UK cinemas in the coming months.

articles.title: Jailer 2 Dips 20 Percent on Tuesday, India Gross Reaches Rs 462.75 Crore

articles.title: Jogen Chowdhury Turned Memory Dream And Everyday Life Into Art
articles.excerpt: An Ina Puri extract in Hindustan Times returns to the painter's own credo — his memories, dreams and immediate environment as his subjects — as India mourns the artist, who died in Kolkata at 87.
articles.image_caption: Artist Jogen Chowdhury sits in his studio surrounded by his ink drawings, paintings and sculptures. Chowdhury, who died on October 25 at the age of 87, made his memories, dreams and immediate surroundings the subject of his work.
articles.nri_angle: For the diaspora, Chowdhury's refugee-to-Kolkata story and his art of memory and home speak directly to families whose own histories cross Partition and migration.

articles.title: Hanuman Ansh Ends Historic Run at Rs 341.76 Crore, 2026's Most Profitable Film
articles.excerpt: The Hindi devotional drama, made for an estimated Rs 1.8 crore, closes its 80-day run as Bollywood's most profitable film of 2026 — but misses the Rs 350 crore milestone and finishes below Border 2.
articles.nri_angle: The devotional drama grossed Rs 48.80 crore overseas on community word of mouth, a standout diaspora performance for a star-less Hindi title.

articles.title: Saif Ali Khan, Vidya Balan Reunite for Ritesh Batra's Long Years Ago in Mumbai

articles.title: Comedian Abijit Ganguly Leaves Mumbai After Nine Years, Citing 'Life in Hard Mode'

articles.title: AI Behind India's 'Mahabharat' Heads to Indonesia to Bring Nusantara Myths to the Screen
articles.excerpt: Galleri5 and Collective Studios' Historyverse will work with Indonesian creators and the Singhasari Special Economic Zone on mythology, fantasy and history projects, starting with 'Echoes of Nusantara'

articles.title: Tu Hai Meri Kiran Review: A Clever Time-Phone Premise the Second Half Cannot Carry
articles.excerpt: Sonakshi Sinha and Zaheer Iqbal lead Karan Rawal's Hindi thriller about a phone that connects 2026 to 2016. Critics praise the idea and the performances, then fault the convoluted payoff.
articles.image_caption: Sonakshi Sinha and Zaheer Iqbal appear in promotional art for Tu Hai Meri Kiran, with Iqbal holding the phone that drives the plot. The Hindi thriller, directed by Karan Rawal, opened in theatres on October 23, 2026.
articles.nri_angle: A new Hindi theatrical release reviewed for diaspora audiences deciding between a cinema trip now and waiting for streaming.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

data_cards.rating_consensus: Across three early published reviews, critics praise the time-crossed phone premise, the unpredictable first half and the lead performances, and fault a convoluted second half, unexplained rules for the device, and a climax that does not resolve the setup. The two rated reviews — Bollywood Hungama at 2.5/5 and India Forums at 2/5 — average just above 2 out of 5; The Videshi rates it 2.5/5 on the strength of its first half and performances.
